# Price the coat, not just the breed.

> Free pet grooming price calculator: size, coat, matting, add-ons, and mobile travel go into one transparent quote with break-even and target-margin price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
